item.title: MySQL Setup
item.description: This guide uses MySQL 8.4 LTS and two native Speedle processes: PMS writes policies, and ADS reads the same database with a separate read-only account. The local example uses Docker and plain HTTP on loopback. For a remote deployment, use your existing MySQL server and the Security guide. 1.
